parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `text` answers in prose, `image` produces a picture from the prompt, and `text_image` reasons first and then produces one. `image` and `text_image` on an uploaded image edit it rather than generate a new one.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Longer side of the picture the model generates, in pixels; the shorter side follows the input's aspect ratio. These are the sizes this image was measured at. Ignored by `text`, whose answer is prose.
